'''SandrockCustom22 Invasion, by Sandrock''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[SandrockCustom22]]
* '''Published:''' 25 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif|label=Invasion}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Invasion SandrockCustom22 DS 2004.txt|Download]] (omits Imperial Propaganda (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

An Invasion deck abusing We're In Attack Position Now, and Naboo Occupation.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 58 as published.
* Posted '3B3-808' dested 3B3-888 (the only other 3B3 droid); 'Droid Blaster Rifle' Battle Droid Blaster Rifle; 'Maul's Double Bladed Lightsaber' Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber.
* Original-era (V): Imperial Propaganda (V) (VS6). Lord Maul (unique) posted x2; dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

This deck is meant to force choke, and cause large amounts of damage.  First turn, drop some cheap deploy droids down to the swamp and whatever site I pull, and Occupation.  Next turn I should be able to drain for 4 force.  Later, use the Flagship to pull Dofine, who pulls Activate the Droids.  We're In Attack Position Now causes direct damage for sites controlled by Commanders, which are why there are so many Tank Commanders.  Flip quickly, and drain for tons.  If all goes according to plan, I can do 17 damage a turn.  The deck benefits from large destinies, which are easy to draw with the flip side of the objective.
